top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §744.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that the school failed to report to Child Care Regulations that a child had been involved in any on-routine situation that placed, or may have placed, the child at risk for injury or harm when left unsupervised for a period of time within the required timeframe.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.305(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the investigation findings this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance. An incident occurred where a child required hospitalization on 06/07/2023. The incident was not reported to Child Care Regulation (CCR) timely; the incident was reported to CCR on 06/15/2023.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The vans were observed during the inspection and did not have a fire extinguisher.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §744.3255(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The loose fill is not being maintained at the proper depth under and around the large playground structure.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Food Allergy Emergency Plan (26 TAC §744.605(16))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 7 children with diagnosed food allergies did not have signed food allergy emergency plans or medication present for their allergies.
